scope: Tracked word first selection, repeated callback, deselect and reselect
findings: Kalem, İstanbul, QRmenü show suggestions on first tracked selection and repeated identical callback; after actual deselect/reselect each shows none.
Lowercase kalem remains editable and suggested after deselect/reselect via synthetic evidence.
Repeated identical selection callback alone does not cause disappearance.
root_cause: First selection consumes history; deselection clears selection composing state; subsequent selection relies on synthetic path, which cannot map uppercase letters. Same root cause as round4/104, newly verified intermittent trigger.
limits: Core fake-document sequence, not proof that a specific app emits transient nil selectedText.
Typed words committed with literal protection to isolate selection behavior.
